title: Letta Code 作例・解説動画
message: 記憶の変更を、保存前に点検する
operation: 実際の Git の検査が、案内の無い変更を止める
案内だけを戻した別の試行で、もう一度点検
保護された設定の変更が止まるのを確かめる
保存した結果を読み、JSON で保存
audience: エージェントの記憶をファイルと Git で管理したい日本語の開発者・初めて Letta Code の MemFS の決まりを知る人
next_action: 作例ページ（../index.html#L02）で L02 と L03 を行き来し、原典の診断と HEAD・stage を読み、1件の JSON を保存する

output.orientation: landscape only; on phones the whole 16:9 canvas is scaled down by CSS. No portrait or square composition is authored or claimed.

authorship.film_code_and_japanese_copy: Claude Opus 5.5 (claude-opus-5-5) wrote index.html, video.css, video.js, storyboard.json and README.md in this folder. This authoring step is separate from the runtime: no model ran inside the checks.
authorship.inputs: input/memory-changes.json (fictional book-club memory, initial policy, L01–L08) and input/expected.json were fixed by the Studio Yebisu production side before execution.
authorship.execution: The production side ran run.mjs with Node v24.18.0 and Git in eight new private repositories. Values in the record were returned by the unmodified Letta Code functions, the original validator script in a real pre-commit, and Git — not by a model.
authorship.screenshots: video/assets/phone.jpg and desktop.jpg are unedited native in-app Chromium screenshots of the Studio Yebisu viewer page, captured by the production side (screens.json).

manifest.rule: video.js hashes the manifest bytes first, then requires its format, source_commit and the eight path/sha256/bytes entries to equal the values frozen in video.js before fetching anything else.

files.role: public actual run record: eight inputs, API/CLI/git commit results, HEAD and stage before/after, 208 runner checks
independent production-side checks against actual Git objects/index, frozen input bytes and the original hook; repair_pair_diff; root code points
fresh Node process in a separate source copy and new repositories reproduced the entire record byte-identically (same machine, fixed fictional Git dates)
frozen fictional input; every record input must equal it
pinned upstream letta-ai/letta-code 316e4c0 (0.34.14, Apache-2.0) and the eight original files

screenshot provenance: phone L02 375×812 (rgb_sha256 bd639681ec0d3952a9784cc25e1be0cd7781a043ad766edc2b836624c3f41e80), desktop L03 1265×889 (rgb_sha256 6ee636d15eb794973c2a6238b2a28a9d9135caf521ad72baa910615f18b6feda)
viewer on a phone width: L02 rejection and the repair link
viewer on a desktop width: L03 successful separate attempt and file tree

sources.fetch_rule: Same-origin fetch of assets/<name> relative to document.baseURI with response.ok required. Missing file, HTTP error, byte length or SHA-256 mismatch, a different pinned commit/version/license, validator hash, runtime, input, per-case outcome, count, repair difference, L08 result, independent or reproduction check, screenshot provenance, JPEG signature or decoded dimensions rejects window.motionReady. No embedded fallback; the captured-image RGB hashes are carried as provenance and are not recomputed in the browser.

upstream.skill_scope: initializing-memory SKILL.md was applied only for Harness Constraints, the root-first index structure and the structural part of 9. Verify, on fictional fixtures. The /init flow (history detection/analysis, questions, subagents, other models, memory editing) was not run.

scope.shown: Real exported Letta Code MemFS validation functions and the original validator script in a real Git pre-commit, on a fictional memory in eight separate new private repositories; the Studio Yebisu viewer page that reads the saved record.
not_shown_or_claimed: agent conversation, model inference, automatic remembering or recall
a real user's or agent's memory or adopted policy
live Git or Letta Code in the browser
automatic repair: L03 is a separate trial whose input was fixed before execution
exact boundary inputs at 900 or 1200 characters (only over-limit variants L04 901 and L06 1201 were run; 900/1200 are configured limits)
security, correctness of memory content or human approval from a passing check
a new OS, other tools or other fonts (reproduction was on the same machine)
continuous screen recording (this is an edited code film)
scope.excluded_from_screen: No fake terminal, chat, progress or invented UI; no full hashes on film; English diagnostics only as smaller supplemental lines; full details remain in the viewer.

design.fonts: Local system fonts only: Yu Mincho / Hiragino Mincho for headlines, Yu Gothic UI / Hiragino Sans for Japanese text, Consolas / Menlo for paths and diagnostics. No downloads.

type_scale_px_at_1280.headlines: 62–68, one or two lines, at most 11 Japanese characters per line

design.phone_reading: At a 360px viewport the canvas is about 328px wide (scale ≈ 0.256): headlines ≈ 16px, counts ≈ 26px, read flow ≈ 12px. Paths, diagnostics and captions are supplemental at that width; the viewer keeps the full text.
design.labels: The scene 2 map is captioned 説明図 and uses only the actual L02 file paths and staged statuses. Screenshots are captioned 閲覧ページの実画面 and drawn whole (contain) from the verified bytes, scaled only.
persistent: masthead: Letta Code <version from record> ・ 記憶の検査の作例; step rail 編集 / 止まる / 戻す / 保護 / 読む with the current step underlined in rust

design.motion: Ease-out fades and short rises computed from absolute time; one sweep line in scene 1; one stroke-through and dashed outline for the deleted index; an arrow for 900 → 1100. Scenes dip to paper over 0.35 s between them.

contract.canvas: getContext('2d', { willReadFrequently: true }); backing store equals renderConfig width × height; layout authored at 1280×720 and scaled; CSS scales the whole 16:9 canvas in the editor
contract.seek: window.seek(seconds) clamps to 0..28 and returns a Promise that resolves after the requested frame is drawn from absolute time and the verified assets only; no frame depends on earlier frames, wall clock or randomness
contract.ready: window.motionReady resolves after the manifest and the eight files match SHA-256 and byte length, all record invariants pass, both original JPEGs match their signature and decoded dimensions, and local fonts are loaded; otherwise it rejects, the canvas is cleared and hidden, controls are disabled and #retry re-fetches everything
contract.export_mode: window.__MOTION_RENDER__ === true: editor chrome hidden, canvas only at exact size, no requestAnimationFrame preview
contract.preview: Starts paused at 0, no autoplay. #play toggles 再生/一時停止 (aria-pressed); #time (range 0–28 step 0.1) seeks; #time-label shows the current time; scene buttons seek to a reading moment; #editor[data-state] is loading, ready or error; #editor-status says what was checked
